title: content/people.yaml
description: People and their office terms. Field names follow the Person, OfficeTerm, Portrait and Source types in sim/Statecraft.Sim/Content.cs; a test keeps them equal.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

checked.description: The day you opened the source.

title_he_form.description: feminine: the person's Hebrew office titles take the offices' title_he_f (שרת העבודה). Leave out for the masculine title_he. Source it in biography_sources.title_he_form.

died.description: Every office term must end by this day.

biography_sources.description: Sources for each biography value. Keep a source for every value you set.

living.description: Required. A living person is left out of release builds.

party.description: A party id from parties.yaml. Empty means no list.

competence.description: A game-balance value, not a fact.

loyalty.description: A game-balance value, not a fact.

focus_y.description: Height of the face centre as a share of the picture: 0 top, 1 bottom.

to.description: End of the term (exclusive). Leave out if it continues.

party.description: The list the holder sat for in this term. Empty means the person's party.

reviewed_by.description: The GitHub handle of the person who signed this row off (#375): written only by that person, never by an AI agent (scripts/oss/reviewed_by_guard.py); never an email. Needs reviewed_on.

reviewed_on.description: The day of that sign-off. Needs reviewed_by.
